settings.title: Settings
settings.summary: Features you can switch on or off. Only you change them; agents can read but not change.
settings.changeTrail.about: Records who changed which file, and when.
settings.changeContent.about: Keeps a copy of each change's content so you can see the difference.
settings.liveUpdates.about: Open pages refresh by themselves when files change.
settings.mentions.about: Finds names that appear in other pages without a link.
settings.needsTrail: Works while the change trail is on.
settings.shadowAbout: Deletes stored content copies and the previous versions of external changes. Who, when and which file stay recorded.
settings.shadowConfirm: I confirm deleting the stored content copies.
settings.invalidBody: The settings file in your data folder has an invalid value, so nothing can be changed.
